tasks.short: Complete production reports and purchase orders.

steps.what: Complete material and equipment lists
Draft production reports from stored rows

loop.purpose: Draft the production report from stored rows.
loop.output: Report prose in which every claim restates a stored row.
loop.check: Every number matches a stored row, and every claim is a restatement of that row.
loop.stop: Stop when a number or a claim has no row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A blank form cannot tell whether the sentence is supported.

steps.what: Complete purchase orders after checking claims
Sign the production report
File the signed production report
outputs: filed copy of signed production report v1

tasks.design: A job fills material, tool, and equipment lists from stored rows in {ERP}. A bounded draft writes the production report only from those rows and stops when a number or a claim has no row. The engineer reads each claim, completes the purchase orders, and signs. A later job files that signed set in {DOCS}. A sentence the rows do not support is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were typed from memory, so a sentence could have no row.
tasks.enabler_now: The lists and the report figures are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The engineer still has to mean what the report says.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides the report is fit to file.

ambition.what: File a signed report the week the rows are complete.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the claims, not on retyping lists.

reach.task: Use only the signed purchase order

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a draft is filled from records, every number traces to a row, and the engineer signs.
Digest [S20] says a paper was asked to be withdrawn because there was no confidence in its data, so a sentence with no stored row is dropped.

assumptions: Every claim restates a stored row.
The engineer checks the meaning before signing.
unknowns: Who else must sign a purchase order.
research_questions: How often a report sentence has no stored row.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining checking time is still the engineer reading the claims.

incremental.description: Remap price and quantity fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes rows are incomplete. The high end assumes rows are complete. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate quality control to resolve problems.

steps.what: Show costs of open production problems
Coordinate quality control objectives and procedures
Implement activities to resolve production problems
Sign the quality control plan
File the signed quality control plan
outputs: filed copy of signed quality control plan v1

tasks.design: A job shows the cost of open production problems as stored quantities times the price table in {ERP}. The engineer coordinates and implements quality control objectives, activities, or procedures to resolve the problems, maximize product reliability, or minimize costs. A later job files the signed plan in {DOCS}. It does not close a problem by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Problem costs were rebuilt before the quality meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: The problems and the prices are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving a problem still takes the floor.

ambition.what: Set a quality action the week the problem cost is posted.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the problem, not on the arithmetic.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a cost is stored quantities times a price table, so the job multiplies those stored figures and does not invent a rate.
The executive digest says advice, design, and research stay manual.

assumptions: A cost is a stored quantity times a stored price.
research_questions: How often a problem has no quantity.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining coordination time is still the engineer.

incremental.description: Remap price and quantity fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes problem costs are missing. The high end assumes problem costs are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Dispose of discrepant and defective parts.

steps.what: Price discrepant material from the price table
Implement methods and procedures for disposition
Assess responsibility for defective damaged parts
Sign the disposition decision
File the signed disposition decision
outputs: filed copy of signed disposition decision v1

tasks.design: A job prices discrepant material from stored quantities and the price table in {ERP}. The engineer implements the methods and procedures for disposition of that material and of defective or damaged parts, and assesses cost and responsibility. Responsibility is a process or a supplier lot, not a score of a worker. A later job files the signed decision in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disposition cost was rebuilt, and blame was pointed at a named person.
tasks.enabler_now: The quantities and prices are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The right disposition still depends on the part in hand.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides the disposition and the responsibility.

ambition.what: Decide a disposition the week the lot cost is posted.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the part, not on the arithmetic.

reach.task: Move stock only from the signed decision

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a cost is stored quantities times a price table, so the job multiplies those stored figures and does not invent a rate.
Digest [S18] bars a solely automated decision about a worker, so a person sets any standard that affects staff.

assumptions: Responsibility is not a score of a worker.
A cost is a stored quantity times a stored price.
research_questions: How often a lot has no price.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining disposition time is still the engineer's decision.

incremental.description: Remap price and quantity fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes lot prices are missing. The high end assumes lot prices are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate processes, staff needs, and standards.

steps.what: Apply statistical methods to stored process rows
Determine manufacturing processes and production standards
Determine staff requirements for the process
Sign the production standard
File the signed production standard
outputs: filed copy of signed production standard v1

tasks.design: A job applies coded statistical methods and mathematical calculations to stored process rows in {BI}. There is no solver call. The engineer determines the manufacturing processes, the production standards, and the staff requirements. Staff requirements are a headcount for the process, not a time study and not a score of a person. A later job files the signed standard in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same sums were redone in a fresh sheet, sometimes against named people.
tasks.enabler_now: The process rows are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A calculation can be right and still be the wrong standard.

ambition.what: Set a standard the week the process rows are posted.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the standard, not on the arithmetic.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says recurring status is a dashboard on stored rows, and a root-cause view is statistics rather than a new narrative.
Digest [S19] requires works-council consent before a time study of presence, behaviour, or performance, so this design does not study named people.
Digest [S18] bars a solely automated decision about a worker, so a person sets any standard that affects staff.

assumptions: The calculation is coded statistics, not a solver.
No named person is studied or scored.
unknowns: Which process rows are in the period.
Who else must accept a staff number.
research_questions: How often a process row is missing.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining calculation time is still the engineer setting the standard.

incremental.description: Remap price and quantity fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes process rows are thin. The high end assumes process rows are complete. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The industrial engineer spends the week on the method, the standard, and the signed text. A stored quantity times a stored price, and filing that text, can move. No model changes a layout, a safety function, or a worker's record.
reach: A production lead follows only the sequence the engineer signed.
A buyer uses only the cost note the engineer signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a cost that is not a stored quantity times a stored price.
Refuse a study of a named person's presence or output.
role.ambitious_version: A signed production report can be filed the same week, and the engineer still owns the standard.
